summary: Untrusted content source-to-sink policy is implemented as security_execution::source_to_sink. It defines source labels, sink classes, trust boundary preserving sanitized summaries, denial rules for untrusted or model-origin content driving high-risk sinks, and PolicyEvaluated audit records for denied attempts without preparing effects. safety::prompt_injection now directly validates prompt-injection fixtures against the same policy.

acceptance.evidence: security_execution::source_to_sink::tests::external_content_defaults_to_untrusted creates external content with SourceLabel::ExternalUntrustedContent and TrustBoundary::ExternalUntrusted.

acceptance.criterion: Untrusted text cannot directly create execute, privileged, network exfiltration, or secret-use actions.
acceptance.evidence: untrusted_text_cannot_directly_create_dangerous_sinks blocks svc.restart, fs.write.diff, privileged host action, http/network egress, and secret.read sinks from external content.

acceptance.criterion: Sanitized summaries retain source labels and do not erase trust boundaries.
acceptance.evidence: sanitized_summary_retains_origin_and_does_not_erase_trust_boundary keeps original_trust_boundary=ExternalUntrusted while allowing read-only influence and denying execute influence.

acceptance.criterion: Denied source-to-sink attempts are audited without EffectPrepared.
acceptance.evidence: denied_source_to_sink_attempts_are_audited_without_effect_prepared emits one PolicyEvaluated event with source label and sink class, and no EffectPrepared.

acceptance.criterion: Operator-approved actions still require exact approval token binding.
acceptance.evidence: operator_approved_actions_still_require_exact_approval_token_binding allows operator source through source-to-sink policy, then verifies PlanStepPolicyAdapter pauses without token and only issues a lease after exact approval.
